decision.name: FREEZE_SOURCE_ONLY_ORACLE_REQUIRE_EXECUTED_EVIDENCE
decision.finding: Exact-SHA runner.run_once reads a locked archive snapshot, releases that lock, then writes latest.json, audit_latest.json and anata_latest.json sequentially without snapshot-generation admission. The existing bounded fixed-T two-process single-handoff regression is already sufficiently precise; inventing another source-only refinement would not improve confidence. Do not treat earlier three-file atomicity as a consumer requirement. Prioritize independent red/green execution, not another unexecuted hypothetical or Gemini task.

Create test-only overlay part2/capital_flow/tests/test_runner_single_handoff_stale.py with top-level multiprocessing spawn targets, child-local monkeypatch of runner.atomic_write_json, bounded Event/Queue, and finally release/terminate cleanup.

At fixed as_of_ms T, A reads empty archive and pauses before replacing anata_latest.json; append unique valid PIT BTC ETF rowB (effective/available/observed <=T); B runs and publishes; assert B handoff source_evidence.clock_provenance references rowB, then release A and assert final single handoff still retains rowB; record actual baseline result, no assumed FAIL.

Execute python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests/test_runner_single_handoff_stale.py; python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests/test_archive_concurrent_dedup.py part2/capital_flow/tests/test_atomic_handoff_visibility.py; python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests. Capture exact SHA, overlay hash, exit codes, non-skipped counts and logs; C independently audits.
Do not require unrelated latest.json and audit_latest.json transactional update; keep archive lock replacement TOCTOU as separate unproven operator-interleaving concern.
